Descrivi ogni radiografia e il confronto: Describe each X-ray and the comparison over time.
Nella polmonite COVID-19 la radiografia:
In COVID-19 pneumonia the chest X-ray may be normal at onset. The typical picture is ground-glass opacities and consolidations that are bilateral, peripheral, predominant in the mid and lower zones, peaking around days 10-12 from symptom onset. Pleural effusion is rare and suggests something else (superinfection, heart failure).
The bedside (AP) X-ray magnifies the cardiac silhouette and makes subtle opacities less visible: in the comparison, the same technique matters. Report classifications (for example the RSNA categories “typical, indeterminate, atypical, negative” for CT and severity scales such as the RALE score for X-ray) help to compare exams.
